name: MI PDF Inserter
author: moinulit

sections.description:
MI PDF Inserter lets you easily upload and display PDF files anywhere on your WordPress site.
Simply use the shortcode [mi_pdf_fullpage] to embed PDFs with built-in View and Download options.

Features

  • Upload and manage PDFs from the admin panel
  • Display full-page PDFs using shortcode [mi_pdf_fullpage]
  • Includes View and Download buttons with icons
  • Responsive and lightweight viewer
  • Works with any theme

Credits

Developed by Moinul Islam, creator of Mi Plugins
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to PDF Inserter in the admin dashboard
  4. Add or select your PDF
  5. Use shortcode [mi_pdf_fullpage] in any post or page
sections.faq:
How can I display a PDF?

Use the [mi_pdf_fullpage] shortcode in your post or page.

Can I upload a new PDF from the editor?

Yes. You can upload or select from the media library in the admin panel.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes, the PDF viewer is fully responsive.
